message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Go

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:

  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.16.x]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v6
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}

    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

    - name: Build
      run: go build -v ./...

    - name: Test
      run: go test -v ./...",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Go CI that fetches dependencies on every run but has no dependency cache, while go.mod and go.sum are present. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and the measured Go experiment (batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) support caching the Go module cache (~/.go/pkg/mod) keyed on runner.os and hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum'), with preserved test success and measured elapsed savings. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, lockfile inputs exist, and no equivalent cache already exists. The change adds one cache step after Set up Go and before Build/Test, preserving the existing matrix, build step, test step, and required coverage without adding privileges, secrets, publishing, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
